name: DELTARUNE Battles [WIP]
desc:
Welcome to DELTARUNE BATTLES!
Update soon!

Controls:
Z/K - Confirm
X/L - Cancel
C/M - Menu

Enter the Dojo in Castle Town to fight the enemies!
You can play against your party by opening the Party menu with more than one person in your party!

DELTARUNE Battles is a fangame of DELTARUNE developed by Toby Fox.
